test.role: held-out: scored once with the frozen selection

train.role: selection: the parameter grid and the frozen selection rule read only this window

protocol.selection_rule: On train only: eligible grid points have every dataset scored, no liquidated leg and >= 6 train positions; pick max mean DD-adjusted return, then max mean Sharpe, then earliest grid order. No eligible point: the seed is used and the selection outcome is recorded.
protocol.sizing: full capital per position, unlevered (Backtester default). execution_spec models fees, spread, slippage, lot floor and the venue minimum; it does not model leverage, margin or liquidation, and at 1x a liquidation cannot occur

verdict_criteria.fail: data sufficient and any pass check false
inconclusive_if_any: fewer than 30 candidate positions across coins on test
any coin's test window has open-interest-valid bars below 90% of its scored bars
verdict_criteria.live_status: backtest_only=True regardless of the verdict; promotion needs a separate reviewed decision
pass_if_all: candidate test net PnL > 0 at cost x1 and at cost x2
candidate test mean DD-adjusted return > both baselines at cost x1
no single coin carries more than 60% of the candidate's absolute test PnL
